items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: And we had Skeets Franklin, the bass player from Brooklyn ... And he was playing with us

ctx.x: With all of my friends. He says, "Who do you want to go with you?" I says, "Well, him. Him." And we had Skeets Franklin, the bass player from Brooklyn -- yeah, he's from Brooklyn. And he was playing with us, so I said, "I want him, him, and --," and I took all my friends home with me.
